title: Fire Septum open fire forecast, version 1
description: Probability of NEW VIIRS active fire in each 400 m block of a 6.4 km box during the 24 h after issuedAt. Sealed as canonical JSON (sorted keys) -> SHA-256 -> OpenTimestamps, and scored with the forecast register's rules. See docs/forecast-schema.md.

id.description: Stable model id. 'fire-septum-ca', 'distance' and 'climatology' are reserved for the scorer.

issuedAt.description: When the forecast was made (ISO 8601 with time zone). The scored window is (issuedAt, issuedAt + windowH]; no detection at or before issuedAt is scored.

grid.description: 16 x 16 blocks of 4 x 4 cells of 100 m, row-major from the north-west block.

metadata.description: Free-form: inputs used, training period, anything else. Sealed with the forecast, not scored.

box.description: Centre of the 6.4 km box: 64 x 64 cells of 100 m, cell (0,0) at the north-west corner; half-widths 3200 m / 111320 m per degree of latitude, and / (111320 cos(lat)) per degree of longitude.

probabilities.description: P(new VIIRS fire in the block during the window) for the 256 blocks, row-major from the north-west block (index = row * 16 + column).
